scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the closed-form expressions from the fixed public parameters and compares each row's values within tolerances. No external gold files needed; all comparison is deterministic.

schema.description: Each row corresponds to one inelastic strain value; all values are floats.

outputs.description: Computed thermodynamic quantities for the two-beam elasto-plastic composite. The checker recomputes the same closed-form expressions using the identical parameter set and E^i list, then compares each numeric field against the agent's submission with appropriate relative/absolute tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The CSV must use exactly the column order and names listed. E^i values must be linearly spaced from 0.0 to 0.1 in 20 steps (i.e., 0.0, 0.005263..., ..., 0.1).
